name: IE-Bench-CoT-mixed
description: IE-Bench-CoT-mixed evaluates models' ability to perform information extraction (IE) tasks while using chain-of-thought style prompting. It contains a mixture of IE subtasks (e.g., named entity recognition, relation extraction, slot-filling) and measures both extraction accuracy and the quality of intermediate reasoning traces. The benchmark is intended to study whether CoT-style explanations improve structured-output extraction under varied prompts and input distributions.
reputation: Relatively niche and recent dataset primarily used in research probing CoT-style prompting for structured information extraction; limited but growing adoption.
